development.fold_rule: v9 development_fold 0..6; former v9 target topic_index+7 gives 7..12

selection_weighting: equal questions within observer, equal A/B
primary_support: A/B mean question-block delta < -1e-12; descriptive only
advance_threshold_scope: Pragmatic next-study threshold; not derived from power or promised by past results.

observation.method: Read full blinded text and manually supply rubric codes; no keyword labels. Separate contexts; no post-score adjudication.

question_authorship: Assistant in the design context; no subject-model forward pass used.
novelty_review: 96 distinct topic strings, checked against all 60 old topic strings. Assistant reviewed task subject/mechanism; no independent human novelty review claimed. Shared authored evidence templates intentionally remain.
stopping: One generation attempt. Preserve failure and partial records; no same-run retry/resume. Incomplete labels/data mean no primary judgment. No adding observations until a desired sign appears.
limitations: v9 co-primary failed; H_gate rank is descriptive.
MPS plus new question bank differs from historical CPU; no causal attribution to backend.
No significance or population interval claim.
No personality mechanism, persistent persona, semantic correctness or cross-device token-identity claim.
pending_before_generation: Record the chosen blinded-observer arrangement in a separate hashed assignment record.
Bind fit lock, prepared run lock, observer assignment and this protocol in a study lock before dispatch.
